title: Lady Six Sky (Ix Wak Chanil Ajaw) of Naranjo
note: Dos Pilas princess who arrived at Naranjo in 682 (Naranjo Stela 24) and acted as regent for K'ak' Tiliw Chan Chaak; died 741. Key study: Helmke 2017, Contributions in New World Archaeology 11:83–130. Naranjo site coordinate on GeoNames (17.133511, -89.262047). Woman ruler; under-recorded.

title: Lady Yohl Ik'nal, ruler of Palenque (583–604)
note: One of very few Classic Maya women to rule in her own right for a full term (21 years); Kaan attack of 599 on Palenque in her reign. Skidmore 2010 Rulers of Palenque (Mesoweb), after Martin and Grube 2008.

title: Arrival of Sihyaj K'ahk' at Tikal (Teotihuacan entrada)
note: 8.17.1.4.12 11 Eb 15 Mak (Jan 378; 14 or 16 Jan Gregorian by 584283/584285). Stuart 'Arrival of Strangers' (Mesoweb), Tikal Stela 31, Naachtun Stela 24 (mayadecipherment.com), conquest vs. other readings as perspectives; Spearthrower Owl.

title: Defeat of Tikal in the star war of 562
note: Caracol Altar 21 (dedicated 633 by K'an II); start of the ~130-year Tikal Hiatus; victor contested (Caracol's Yajaw Te' K'inich II vs. Kaan ruler Sky Witness, Martin 2005 PARI Journal 6(1)).

title: Terminal Classic Maya collapse
note: c. 800–1000 CE; drought (Kennett et al. 2012; Evans et al. 2018 Science; Medina-Elizalde & Rohling 2012), multi-causal human-environment model (Turner & Sabloff 2012 PNAS, PMC3435155), warfare (Canuto et al. 2018). ~90% population decline in central lowlands.

title: Calakmul (seat of the Kaan dynasty)
note: UNESCO WHC 1061 (2002, extended 2014); 120 stelae; Kaan capital moved from Dzibanché; Structure II; needs model (footprint, phases).
